zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Fairfield Township Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 1.89%, with an equalization ratio of 87.2%.
Public education represents 48.6% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 35.2%.
Average residential assessment is $549,360, producing an average annual tax bill of $10,382.9.

equityAnalysis.summary: Fairfield Township maintains a consistent residential tax base across its residential zones.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Fairfield Township, homeowners pay an average of $10,382.9 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.09% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 87.2%, assessed values average ~87.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 48.6% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 35.2%, and Essex County claims 16.2%.
